messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: proto(Geom, ... in other packages
parts:
Hi all -

For the time being I need to create a non-exported version of anntotation_custom for the package ggmap.  In the process of putting it in, I have to go through the line

GeomCustomAnn <- proto(Geom, {

which won't roxygenize or go through R CMD check.  Without having to go through the proto vignette, what's an easy way for me to make this go through?

Thanks!
david.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: proto(Geom, ... in other packages
parts:
I think this might work:
  proto(ggplot2:::Geom, ...

-Winston
